column1: Edens Edge Landscaping — GHL Category → Custom Value Mapping Sheet
VA Reference Document — Use this when building category pages in GHL. Based on Ethan's actual form responses.
1.  Each tab = one category page to build in GHL.
2.  Every service listed in a tab must appear on that category page — including yellow duplicate rows.
3.  Yellow rows = cross-category duplicates. The custom value is defined ONCE. Reuse the same key — do NOT create a new one.
4.  MASTER CROSS-REF tab = quick lookup for any service appearing on multiple pages.
5.  GBP setup: add ALL services shown per category tab to the Google Business Profile, including duplicates.
6.  Cat 4 (Lawn Care): Ethan skipped this section. Services are populated from the duplicate tracking doc — all are reused keys from other categories.
